steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Thank you, Tomimi. I'll definitely return the favor once we get back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I-I'm not sure I make a very good lookout, but I'll give it my best shot!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Alright, time for a taste!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hmm, currant mead has a rather strange bite to it, but...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: M-Mr. Elysium!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Wh-What's wrong? Are our friends looking for us? You have to tell them I'm not drinking somebody else's liquor––

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It's Mr. Stitch!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: *huff*... Took me long enough to find you people.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Speaking of which, what's this guy doing here?

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Yo, Stitch.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: How many years has it been since we saw each other? How awful of you. I bet you haven't even gone to see my Great Aquapit?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Talk about timing though! Now that you're here, should we head down there together? The surfing area's amazing!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: I wouldn't mind releasing the flow valve on the water slide while no one's looking, let you experience a true––

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Thanks, but no thanks. I've got business to attend to.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Everyone, with me. If you're done enjoying yourselves here, it's time to get to work.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Stitch, why are you always in such a hurry? We've got all the time in the world, so why don't we––

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: You might have all the time in the world, but I don't. Unlike Design Representative Catch here, full of vim and vigor, I am an Oripathy sufferer with only a few years left.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Oh, sorry, that's not what I meant!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: What I was trying to say is we ought to sit down and talk things through. Maybe resolve some of our old misunderstandings...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Listen, Catch.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: If recognition is what you're after, you've already won the hearts of Zeruertza's citizens. My opinion doesn't matter.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: If you're trying to cement your legacy, you might as well build a super water cannon or something, maybe even paint it red or pink. I won't stop you.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Just don't waste your breath on me. I'll never be able to compliment your... heh, 'architecture,' in good faith.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Let's go, surface-dwellers. I'll tell you all about my plans...

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Wait, Stitch, hear me out first––

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Let me offer a word of advice: stay away from me.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: We have our own paths to follow.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Why don't we talk about that Super Water Cannon you just mentioned, when you have a minute. You've got me interested.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: But, before that... Did any of you just hear something?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: The merry band of drunkards must be doing something stupid again.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: No, that's not it...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Wait, could it be from the dome...?

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: There's no way. Have some faith in the quality of my engineering, will you?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: L-Look at that!
The feeling of freefall.
Wind rushes loudly past my ears.
Some weirdos at Rhodes Island can't seem to get enough of this sensation. Don't understand them at all.
As for me? There's only one reason I'd ever jump from a height like that: to solve a problem.
Fists, staves, or axes. Anything goes.
You solve a problem by finding the bad guy and beating him down. Nice and simple, right?
No matter what I'm facing––
Even if my axe breaks, my staff splits, and my hands can't make a fist anymore.
All that matters is I got it done.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doesn't matter to me if there's an evil plot, wild beast, mushroom, natural disaster, or some other nasty thing!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'll crush it!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hey, Gavial, something doesn't seem quite right. Look down there.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Lupo
steps.text: Hey, don't make me repeat myself! Unhand me this instant!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, sorry about that.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What the hell's all this? A waterfall? And a slide?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Yahoo!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yo, Gavial, what took you so long?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Welcome to the Durins' Great Aquapit!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Waaah, Gavial, it's all my fault!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: So let me get this straight. There's no giant, horrible monster, and no fire or mushrooms raining from the sky?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Elysium called it a 'rhetorical device'...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm gonna go beat the shit out of him.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Well, what Tomimi said wasn't altogether false. The Durins are having a crisis of some sort.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Though it's not immediately obvious, that is what Mr. Stitch said.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: There's a reason for what I do.

steps.name: Lupo
steps.text: So, what kind of stunt are you uppity surface folks trying to pull here?!

steps.name: Lupo
steps.text: You just broke into Zeruertza brandishing that huge axe, and now you're claiming to be helping the Durins?

steps.name: Lupo
steps.text: What a joke. The Durin people are perfectly capable of solving their own problems. As if they'd ever ask for help from you high-and-mighty surface-dwellers.

steps.name: Lupo
steps.text: What's more, all that filth and nastiness you carry on you is enough to besmirch our little patch of paradise down here!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Uhh, aren't you a Lupo? Aren't you also from the surface?

steps.name: Lupo
steps.text: I've abandoned everything I was once up above. Now, I am only a citizen of Zeruertza.

steps.name: Lupo
steps.text: Therefore, I believe I speak for all the citizens of Zeruertza when I ask you to begone from this city!

steps.name: Lupo
steps.text: If you want to be stubborn about it, I don't mind kicking you out by other means.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Calm down, Avdotya. I brought them here.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Stitch... I didn't know you were back.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I don't know what you're trying to do, but as someone who used to be 'one of them,' I'd urge you to give it up. Relying on the surface-dwellers will only bring ruin to Zeruertza.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Zeruertzans have never seen real greed, a real scheme.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Avdotya, the people already voted to let them stay...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I have no problem overturning that result with another referendum. It all depends on how the Durins see them.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: But if push comes to shove, and you surface folk bare the weapons of violence and bloodshed as you always do, then I will hunt you to the bitter end.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Gah, you're not making any sense. This whole thing's just a misunderstanding.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I heard Acahualla's underground neighbors needed help, so I came to lend a hand. That's all. Helping them is helping us.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Oh yes, you showed up at your neighbor's house with a chainsaw. I'm sure you're just trying to help me fix my table leg. I'm sorry, could you use that huge axe to help me cut some fruit?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Don't try to pull a fast one on me. I've seen a kindly Messenger transform into the image of wickedness in the blink of an eye. The pursuit of profit and the lust for conquest is in the nature of all surface-dwellers.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: You might be able to deceive my good-natured Durin friends, but you can't trick me. I'm all too familiar with the venom behind your honeyed words.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Uhh, believe it or not, this axe is, uh, just for self-defense.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But if you think we have to solve this with violence, then I'm more than glad to rumble with you.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Hey, you there, with the axe.

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: You're badass!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Oh... Thanks?

steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: Avdotya, you're the best!

steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: I've only ever seen you scribbling in your notebooks. I never knew you had this side to you!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: What side...?

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: How far up did you come from? How'd it feel to jump down?

steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: How come nobody's ever thought of that before? Jumping off the top of the waterfall!

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: Are these two your friends? Look at you, keeping secrets from us. You never told us you had such cool friends!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: They might be dangerous. We can't...

steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: Can you ask her to take me up there with her next time?

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: Avdotya, did you bring anything back from your last trip? Maybe some more of that fruit from last time?

steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: We haven't seen each other for hours. Let's toast to our reunion!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Wait, hold on!

steps.name: Curious Durin
steps.text: Hey lady, your name is Gavial, right? Can I touch your axe? Is it heavy?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Uhh, it's not too bad?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Durin
steps.text: You got a minute, Gavial? There's a super-secret to having fun in the Great Aquapit! I'm sure you'll give us the biggest, flashiest splash ever!

steps.name: Curious Durin
steps.text: Here's my address in Zeruertza. If you're not busy, swing by tomorrow for one hell of an ale rager!

steps.name: Enthusiastic Durin
steps.text: Why wait for tomorrow? Let's start today!

steps.name: Curious Durin
steps.text: I like the sound of that!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Me too! My good sir Catch, bring us another bottle!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What's up with these Durins? Did they get bitten by Elysium or something?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: That's a look, Tomimi. Something on your mind?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial will always be Gavial. No matter where she goes, she captures all the hearts and minds.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: The way I see it, it's just a band of dumbasses attracted to the biggest, loudest dumbass.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Some people just have that kind of magnetism.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: So this is 'Gavial the Invincible' that the people of Acahualla keep talking about.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: What's she jumping off the waterfall for? Did you plan this?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: No... but I suppose trouble comes in threes.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi, I'm surrounded! Gimme a hand!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Coming!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: It's too rowdy here. Let's move somewhere else.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So you're the Durin.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: While I was in Acahualla, your name was on everyone's lips, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Then tell me, what exactly is this crisis that Zeruertza faces, and how will it affect Acahualla?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: That... To be honest, is an extremely complicated question, involving multiple layers including geography, geology, sociology, and more.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Let's start peeling back those layers.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: The most difficult part is, we can't discuss this topic without delving a little bit into literature first...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Like Tomimi, I also borrowed a few 'rhetorical' tricks.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: In other words, what you told us was an exaggeration?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I wouldn't call it an exaggeration. I just, uh, was looking at things from a more macro-historical level.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: As Terra's crust changes over millions of years, there is indeed a high probability that the entire rainforest will sink into the ground...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Can I beat the snot out of this little runt?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: By all means.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Wait, wait, hold on! I truly do need your help though, and this matter is critically important to Zeruertza!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Let's look at this from a business standpoint! Surely you've seen it too — Durin technology will definitely come in handy in the rainforest!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: The Acahuallans won't have to treasure a few discarded lathes!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Hmm, if you're telling the truth.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I assure you, I'll answer any technical questions the people of Acahualla might have!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: (*mutters*) Heh, assuming you can even understand my answers.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What was that?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I-I said, even if you don't understand at first, I'll try to explain things as best as I can.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Let's cut to the chase then. What exactly are you trying to do?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: It's very simple. Help me convince the others to repair the railway bridge connecting the city. It was damaged in the last earthquake.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: That way, Zeruertza can relocate its Originium detection devices without tossing out this entire damned dome, and I can be free of the old man's constant nagging.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: By the way, feel free to blow up a certain oversized slide blocking the railway bridge. That'd be killing two fowlbeasts with one stone. No, three!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Mr. Stitch, why do you have to build an entire railway instead of just repairing the dome? It'd be a shame to blow up the slide!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Everyone voted to leave the hole there and build the Great Aquapit.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Moreover, repairing the dome poses a series of esoteric technical problems which won't make sense to the likes of you!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: As such, we have to hold a new referendum to get our plan approved!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I'd rather not. I like the slide myself, and it would be a damned shame to blow it up.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Given how handy you Durins are, why do you need us Acahuallans to help you fix the bridge?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Fine... there's no harm in telling you.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: As the designer who proposed the plan to rebuild the railway bridge, I will naturally be put in charge if the proposal passes.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: However! Have you seen the blueprint for the railway bridge? I saw it back when I was in school, and it couldn't deviate any more from my ultra-minimalist design philosophy!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: That dense wiring! That ugly skeleton frame!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: So, I slept through every single one of my railway bridge design classes.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So... you have no idea how to build a railway bridge at all?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Though I hate to admit it, it is my one shortcoming.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: That is why I am enlisting the aid of all skilled Acahuallans, subcontracting this important project to you!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: So how about it? A flawless solution, wouldn't you say?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Durin society must be incredibly tolerant to allow a little shit like him to live this long...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: H-Hey! What do you mean by that?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright, since Zumama is here, she can probably fix up the bridge in no time.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Where'd she go?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I knew it. It wasn't just my imagination.

steps.name: Strange Machine
steps.text: ...WARNING.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Get over here, little fella!

steps.name: Strange Machine
steps.text: Bogey. Danger! Initiating evasive maneuvers!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hey, stay put!
